notes: 'due' is given to the 3ms suffix of עִתּוֹ as what realizes its determination in 'in due season'; the competing reading marks the suffix unrepresented and folds 'due' into עֵת's own unit under rule 31, and is named here under rule 8.
The dative לְ of לָהֶם is unrepresented under rule 40, the ASV writing a bare English indirect object, while its suffix keeps 'them'; the object marker is unrepresented under rule 16.
